_comment: This configuration file is for identifying bride and groom in videos. The 'trello_board' specifies the board on Trello that the software interacts with. 'base_paths' refers to the directories that the software searches for files. 'file_length' is the threshold for the video file length considered by the software. 'skip_frames' refers to the number of frames the model skips during processing. 'frames_per_video' specifies the number of frames the software uses for ceremony video detection and classification. 'model_id_video' is the ID of the model that classifies the ceremony files. 'model_id_bg' is the ID of the model that detects the bride and groom, while 'model_id_face' is the ID of the model that extracts the face. The 'in_list' specifies the list from which the model retrieves cards, while 'process_list' indicates the list where cards are moved when processing starts. Upon successful completion, cards are moved to the 'out_list', and in case of errors, they are moved to the 'error_list'. 'motion_threshold' is the threshold beyond which the model does not consider a video as a tripod video.
